description: This file sets up an express server that provides a web interface and API for visualizing database schemas and data across multiple database engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB. It includes configuration loading, database adapters, and API route handlers.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for different database adapters, provides common interface and helper methods.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Method to test the database connection, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieve list of tables.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetch data from a specific table.

methods.name: formatTableResult
methods.description: Format rows into table name objects.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Base class for SQL-based database adapters, provides execute method and common query implementations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Execute an SQL query, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getTableQuery
methods.description: Return query string to fetch table names, implemented by subclass.

methods.name: getDataQuery
methods.description: Return query string to fetch data from table, implemented by subclass.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL databases, implements execute and query methods.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Run a query using pg Pool.

methods.name: getTableQuery
methods.description: SQL to list tables in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: getDataQuery
methods.description: SQL to select data from a table.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Run a query using mysql2/promise.

methods.name: getTableQuery
methods.description: SQL to list MySQL tables.

methods.name: getDataQuery
methods.description: SQL to select data from a table.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Run a query against SQLite database.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Check existence of the SQLite database file.

methods.name: getTableQuery
methods.description: SQL to list SQLite tables.

methods.name: getDataQuery
methods.description: SQL to select data from a table.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB databases, uses MongoDB Node.js driver.

methods.name: withClient
methods.description: Utility to manage MongoDB connection lifecycle.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Test MongoDB connection.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: List collections in the database.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieve documents from a collection.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Iterates over configured database adapters to test their connectivity.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler to process API requests for database operations.
